title: Revolt of 1857 causes: more causes and books

boxes.title: Political & administrative causes
head: Cause
Effect
rows: ==Indians shut out of high civil and military posts==
Rampant in **lower courts and police**; justice slow, costly, favouring the rich
Princely courts' officials, retainers, soldiers out of work

boxes.title: Economic & social: more
items: **Commercialisation**: forced cash crops under high taxes
Inam Commission at **Bombay**; owners who could not show title lost estates
Artisans: heavy tariffs on Indian goods → ==**deindustrialisation**==, esp. textiles
Also resented: laws against **child marriage**, **female infanticide**
Missionaries preached under **police protection**; railways and telegraph seemed to threaten caste

boxes.title: Army & earlier mutinies: more
items: Europeans drawn off for the ==**Crimean** and **Persian** wars==
Not a cause: officers' inefficiency; WERE causes: missionaries, ship order, bhatta stop
**Vellore**: turban with **leather cockade**; **Tipu's sons** lodged in the fort
Bhatta mutinies **1840s**: 34th NI **1844**, 66th NI **1849-50**; 38th NI **1852** refused Burma

items.what: Rumours: **bone dust** in flour; **chapatis** passed village to village
Pandey also attacked **Sergeant-Major Hewson**; regiment disbanded (⚠ some notes: April)
Meerut: **85** sepoys of **3rd Cavalry** court-martialled, **10** years
